_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every hard number this site publishes. The resume claims 'every figure I publish is emitted by a script that refuses to write a null.' This file plus scripts/check-facts.mjs is what makes that true rather than aspirational.
_meta.rule: A number does not go on the site until it has an entry here with a derivation you could paste into a terminal. If you cannot name the command, the number is a guess and does not ship.
_meta.verifiedBy: read out of the named source file on 2026-09-06; see each fact's derivation
